notes.note: Leader block #0.2-16 (script n1-15) follows the first Pt_Chara_Check chain 9,6,4,11,1,7,5,12,10,2,13,8,3,15,14 (Wing Zero, Nu, W Shotaro, Ultraman, Rider 1, Zeta, OOO, Seven, 00, RX, Taro, God, Den-O Sword, Zero, Mebius). In this slice: #0.12 Taro, #0.13 God Gundam, #0.14 Momotaros (rough), #0.15 Zero, #0.16 Mebius (polite). Fits the wording.
#0.19-33 = second leader block (n18-32), same chain: #0.31 Momotaros (rough), #0.32 Zero, #0.33 Mebius. Identical JP -> identical EN.
Script names Ankh (he is with the party in this Cube). 'Nara' answers the failed controls: if the panel won't work, destroy the cannon.
Self-introduction: name on line 1, then 'kono Cube wo azukatte iru' = this Cube is in his charge.
Reborns taunts them: going may kill them all, which suits him fine. Ankh's reply #0.60 is 'What did you say?'.

#0.61-75 leader block uses the SECOND chain printed after n37: 10,9,6,4,11,1,7,5,12,2,13,8,3,15,14 = 00, Wing Zero, Nu, W Shotaro, Ultraman, Rider 1, Zeta, OOO, Seven, RX, Taro, God, Den-O Sword, Zero, Mebius. Checked against wording (watashi = Ultraman/Seven/Taro at #0.65/69/71, boku = Mebius #0.75, rough = Shotaro/Momotaros/Zero #0.64/73/74). 'Tatoe sou demo' = even if it means the explosion Reborns described; #0.65/#0.71 say 'even if it's a trap'.
'Iku shika nai' given the subject 'I' (the leader is answering for himself, as the other variants do).
Rokushin = reactor core (of the Libra / its cannon); same word in #0.76 and 0651#0.1.

0651 leader block #0.2-16 (n1-15) uses a 14-entry chain without Wing Zero (Heero has his own branch): 6,4,11,1,7,5,12,10,2,13,8,3,15,14 read 0-based = Nu, Shotaro, Ultraman, Rider 1, Zeta, OOO, Seven, 00, RX, Taro, God, Momotaros, Zero, Mebius; #0.16 (story_132) would be a spare slot. The 0-based reading fits the next block (#0.18-32 in story_132) clearly; a 1-based reading would fit this block's last three rows slightly better (#0.15 'da na' is a little rough for Mebius). Rendered #0.15 neutrally so either reading works.
'Sore ni mainasu enerugii mo...' trails off in the source (implied: is intense too); kept as a trailing fragment.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped from the Pt_Chara_Check chains in 0650/0651 and checked against wording; 0650 uses two different chains (second one from n38 on). Uncertain: 0651 block 0- vs 1-based index (#0.15 voiced neutrally). No names outside the glossary; 'reactor core' used for rokushin.
